column1: # drop corrections proposed by scripts/dictionary/review.mjs — see corrections.mjs

column4: This archaic meaning of 'weer' as man is obscure and would only confuse a learner.
'to look after' essentially duplicates the existing 'to care for' meaning of zorgen voor.
circle is essentially the same as the other listed meanings (sphericity, circularity), and "het rond" as a noun is obscure and confusing.
Dutch 'rond' as a noun is rare; 'circularity' is a near-duplicate of the circle/sphericity senses and confuses learners.
'Round of a race' is expressed by 'ronde', not the noun 'rond', so this meaning does not exist for this word.
'Sphericity' is not a real noun sense of 'rond' and duplicates the circle/circularity idea.
The archaic sense 'second' of 'ander' is obscure and only confuses a learner; 'other' and 'different' already cover current use.
This duplicates the other meaning "to be stuffed (full)"; both express the same idea.
It duplicates the basic meaning 'to walk' already listed.
'A pity' is essentially the same meaning as 'too bad', so it duplicates the other meaning.
'Wordless' duplicates 'mute'/'speechless' and the example is an obscure usage that would confuse learners.
'Count' is not a real meaning of 'slag' here and the example actually illustrates the 'stroke (of a clock)' or 'strike' meaning already listed.
This meaning duplicates the existing 'hit' and 'blow' meanings, as the example describes a hit with a bat.
Bereid as an adjective means willing or prepared (ready); the food-sense is the past participle of bereiden, which is a verb form, not a separate adjective meaning, and is confusing.
Act of governing is essentially the same as the 'government' and 'reign' senses, so it duplicates the other meanings and adds confusion.
The gloss 'member' duplicates the other meaning 'member (of a group)'; the penis meaning is listed separately.
Reden means reason; 'ratio' is not a meaning of this word (that is verhouding), and reason is already listed.
Duplicates the other 'trut' meaning (bitch/annoying woman are the same vulgar sense); article 'de' is correct.
Subject duplicates the existing "subject matter" meaning of stof.
The gloss 'medical' is not a translation and duplicates the other meaning 'treatment (medical)'.
'Speciality' is essentially the same as the existing meaning 'field (area of expertise)', so it duplicates it.
Awfully and "extremely" are near-synonymous renderings of the same adverb, so this meaning duplicates the other one.
'Young age' duplicates the 'youth (period)' meaning already listed.
Verzet meaning recreation is only the archaic/rare "verzetje" sense, not a current meaning, and it confuses learners.
The meaning pick (tool or choice) is not a standard sense of Dutch pik; it is a dubious or obscure sense that only confuses learners.
'to print out' duplicates the other meaning 'to print'.
The archaic 'service' sense only confuses learners, and the example actually illustrates the other meaning, 'ministry'.
It duplicates the other euro entry; the other entry has the clearer gloss.
'Hol' as a hill is not a standard Dutch meaning; the sloping-road sense is already listed and it is a place-name sense.
Benefit is not a real meaning of lust, and the example is already covered by the "pleasure" meaning.
Dutch 'link' means dangerous/risky or sly, not 'jolly' (that is a mistaken sense, likely from English 'jolly' confusion), so this meaning does not exist.
This duplicates the Nazi sense extended to similar movements, which is just a broader use of the main meaning.
Article de is correct, but 'acknowledgement' is a near-duplicate of confession and adds little for a learner.
'To become familiar' duplicates the other meaning 'to get used (to)', which is the real sense of wennen.
'Waag' means weighing house/scales; 'water flow' is not a real meaning (only archaic 'waag' for a body of water, obscure).
'Waag' does not mean wave in modern Dutch; archaic and confusing, so drop.
Intercourse in the sense of social dealings is archaic and confusing, and it is not the common meaning of verkeer, so it only confuses a learner.
Verquere is not an English gloss and this archaic sense is obscure, so it is dropped.
Kneeing is not a real noun meaning of knie and the entry duplicates the existing meaning knee.
'Glazen' as a verb is obscure and this is only a non-standard form; the common word is the plural noun of 'glas', so this verb sense is confusing.
'To polish' for verb 'glazen' is obscure and doesn't match common usage, and the word is mostly the noun plural, so it only confuses learners.
'Pastor' and 'parish priest' are the same meaning, so this duplicates the other entry.
'Maal' as 'stain' is an archaic sense (as in moedervlek/maalteken) that only confuses learners.
'Plant' does not mean cabbage; the real meaning 'plant' is already listed.
This is a duplicate of the existing 'black widow' meaning, since zwarte weduwe is simply the black widow spider and the southern species adds nothing for a learner.
It duplicates the other meaning 'to dare (to)', which covers the same sense.
'Deck' is not a meaning of stok; it is not a real sense of this word.
'Stock' as an archaic sense of stok is obscure and confusing for learners, and another entry already lists stock.
The 'mender' sense (from flikken, to mend) is a different, obscure agent noun that is rare and confusing; learners would not use it.
The laager (camp) meaning is obscure and archaic, only confusing a learner, and has no example.
The Eurasian badger is just the specific sense of 'badger', which is already listed, so this duplicates it.
Nuchter does not mean 'newborn'; this meaning does not exist and is probably confused with 'pasgeboren'.
formal meeting and "congress" are the same meaning, so this duplicates the other entry.
The meaning duplicates the other listed meanings 'embassy' and 'embassy building'; the article 'de' is correct.
'Fast-growing' is not a meaning of tijger as a noun; it only comes from the compound tijgereconomie, so the meaning is not real for this word.
material evidence duplicates the other meaning "evidence"; bewijsmateriaal has just one sense.
sexual and "related to sex" are the same meaning, so this one duplicates the other.
per se as a gloss merely repeats the word and the other meaning "necessarily" covers the same sense.
The sense pure is poetic or archaic and gives a learner little, and it overlaps with colorless and white.
This duplicates the other meaning 'to consume (resources or goods)'.
Het treffen as 'meeting' largely duplicates 'encounter' and has no example, so it adds little; the article het is correct anyway.
It largely duplicates the 'effeminate homosexual' meaning in item 4 and adds only a shade of difference.
Luid as a noun meaning sound is archaic or obscure (the word is normally an adjective meaning loud), and it confuses learners.
to get prepared duplicates the other meaning "to prepare".
Schijn is a noun, not an adverb, and the meaning 'appearance' is already listed under the noun.
Duits never meant 'Dutch' in modern usage; this archaic sense only confuses learners, and 'German' is already listed.
'Teutonic' is an archaic, obscure sense that duplicates 'German' and only confuses learners.
The archaic 'expansion' sense is obscure and only confuses learners, and the main meaning 'explanation' is already listed.
Conjuration duplicates the meaning "spell" already listed, and is an obscure gloss.
Sentence as a legal judgment is not a meaning of spreuk (that is vonnis); the meaning is a saying/proverb, already listed.
Multitude duplicates the "crowd" meaning; the article de is correct.
'Pil' for pharmacist is not an established meaning; the slang 'pillendraaier' is the pharmacist word, and the entry is confusing.
'Thick sandwich' is not a real meaning of 'pil' and would only confuse a learner.
Duplicates the other adverb meaning 'north', which already covers direction.
The 'light tincture' sense is a heraldic term (the heraldic 'metal' colors) that only confuses learners, and plain 'metal' is already listed.
'Opposition' here just duplicates the 'contrast' meaning, which is what the example shows.
Truncated gloss "to glow in a white" duplicates the meaning fixed in item 1 and is obscure.
'Piece of chalk' duplicates the 'chalk' meaning of het krijt; the article het is correct.
The archaic meaning 'distant' is obscure and only confuses learners.
'Champion' is not a normal meaning of ridder, and the example only shows the knight meaning, which is already listed.
'Trustworthy friend' is just a loose repeat of the figurative right-hand man meaning, which is already covered.
'To be in command' duplicates the other meaning 'to command'.
Pintle is an obscure technical sense of duim that only confuses a learner; thumb and inch are the real meanings.
Forming into a stool or stump is an obscure forestry sense that only confuses a learner.
A village in Drenthe is an obscure place name on a common word and only confuses learners.
'Greedy person' largely duplicates the 'ruthless person' figurative meaning, which already covers the figurative use.
Effeminate is an adjective sense that duplicates the effete man meaning, which is kept as the noun sense.
Duplicates the other meaning of this regional dish and the 'porridge of ground wheat' gloss is questionable.
It is a noun phrase wrongly typed as an interjection and the same meaning is covered elsewhere as a noun (de gouden medaille).
Archaic 'busy activity' sense is obscure and overlaps with the racket/commotion meaning, so it only confuses learners.
'European mole' duplicates the existing 'mole' (animal) meaning.
to start is not a meaning of kraken; the word means to crack, so this sense does not exist and the other listed senses cover the real ones.
The meaning 'dishonest' is not a real sense of 'jood'; it only repeats an antisemitic stereotype, and the real senses (Jew, Ajax supporter) are already listed.
It duplicates the 'towards' meaning, which is the same sense as 'heading for'.
Esteemed woman duplicates the meaning "noblewoman", and vrouwe is archaic.
Slepen means to drag or tow, and 'to slide' is not a real meaning of it.
'Gains' is essentially the same as the existing meanings 'loot' and 'spoil', so it duplicates them.
process is not a meaning of divisie and the other listed meanings (military unit, company section, sports league) cover it; hyphen is dubious but this meaning does not exist.
Zuid as a bare adverb 'southwards' is unnatural (Dutch uses zuidwaarts or naar het zuiden) and duplicates the other 'south' meaning.
zoet meaning soot is not a real meaning (soot is "roet"), and it is archaic and confusing.
The gloss 'complex' repeats the other two meanings of the adjective, so this entry is a duplicate.
Hypostasis is a obscure theological term that would only confuse a learner.
'sallet' is an obscure archaic English variant of salad and duplicates the existing 'salad' meaning.
'to browse' and 'to leaf' are the same meaning (paging through), so this duplicates the other one.
It duplicates the other imagination meaning and adds nothing distinct for a learner.
gift of money is just a paraphrase of the other meaning "tip", so it duplicates it.
'Something shoven' is not a real English gloss and only repeats the 'shove' meaning.
'Zest' is not a real meaning of drukte, and it has no example.
The archaic 'to work with a plough' duplicates the existing 'to plow (land)' meaning and only confuses learners.
Archaic, obscure meaning (Hague beatnik) that would only confuse learners and duplicates nothing useful; frog and cleat remain.
'Luizen' meaning 'to acquire' is not a real meaning and is obscure, so it only confuses learners.
Fishing with a leusnet is an obscure, dubious meaning that only confuses a learner.

column3: one of the addends in a sum
column4: This mathematical sense is just a specific use of the general meaning 'term' that is already listed, so it is a duplicate.
The phrase 'to work a certain way' is vague and not a real separate meaning; the actual meaning is covered by the other entry.
to talk out duplicates the other meaning "to finish talking"; the example is that same meaning.
Booze duplicates the disgusting drink meaning, which is the real sense of bocht as 'bad drink'.
'High (expectations)' is not a real meaning of stout; it is a confusion with 'hoog' and has no basis.
Duplicates the other protest meaning.
Swimming under water is just a variant of the existing 'dive' meaning, so it duplicates another meaning.
Trainer as coach and trainer as trainer are the same meaning, so this duplicates the other entry.
'Right now' is not a real meaning of althans; it is an invented or archaic sense that only confuses learners.
This is just a group of animals, a sense of 'colony' that is not distinct enough from the general meaning, so it duplicates the main entry.
The seagull-colony sense is a duplicate of the general colony of animals meaning and has a nonsense gloss.
The gloss 'usually specified' is not a meaning, and the example (Indonesia as a colony) duplicates the political colony sense in item 1.
Des duivels means furious (an adjectival phrase), so the gloss "evil" is wrong and the meaning is covered by item 2.
Duplicates the basic 'fox' meaning.
Archaic 'atonement' largely duplicates the 'reconciliation' meaning (zoen as atonement/reconciliation) and only confuses learners.
'Airforce base' is not a standard meaning of vleugel; it is an obscure, doubtful sense that would confuse learners.
'Part of a clap door' is a vague, technical sub-sense of the general 'wing' (leaf of a door/window) meaning and not useful to learners.
'Part of a helix' is an obscure technical sense that only confuses learners.
The adverb sense 'incredibly' is already listed, and the adjective use in the example is separate, so this entry duplicates it.
Sanction is not a real meaning of discipline; it is a stretch from disciplinary measures and overlaps the 'regime of forcing compliance' meaning.
'Kaal' as a noun meaning kehillah does not exist in Dutch; kaal is an adjective meaning bald, and it is a spurious entry with no usable meaning.
'To speak' is not a real meaning of uithalen; it is a mistaken variant of 'to lash out'.
The 'dell' meaning duplicates 'dune valley', which is already listed.
'to put on to' is an unclear gloss that duplicates the meanings 'to start' and 'to urge' (aanzetten tot).
'to set' is vague and overlaps with 'to set (the table)' and 'to stick'; it is not a distinct meaning.
robing room is an obscure sense and the common meanings (dressing room, changing room) are already listed.
The gloss duplicates the other meaning 'generator', so this entry is redundant.
'Figurative trap' is an obscure archaic sense that is not in standard use and only confuses learners; the physical and other meanings remain.
Archaic 'trap' sense of pier is not used in modern Dutch and would only confuse a learner; it is also close to the figurative trap entry.
The archaic 'prison' meaning of pier does not exist in current Dutch and is obscure.
The archaic 'rabbit den' meaning is obscure and has no real modern use.
'EU-member states' is not a meaning of hoofdstad and it is a wrong, junk gloss; the real meaning is already listed in item 1.
'paal' is not an adjective meaning 'faded'; it is a noun meaning pole, and the 'pale' sense is obscure and duplicated by item 5.
'paal' is not an adjective meaning 'pale' in standard Dutch (the word is 'bleek'); it is a noun 'pole', so this adjective entry is wrong and confusing.
'Lam' does mean a young goat only rarely if ever; 'kid' is wrong and duplicates the lamb meaning.
'fluid' duplicates the other meaning 'liquid', so this one is redundant.
Wreken means to avenge; 'to punish' is essentially a duplicate of the revenge meaning.

column3: to annul (a court ruling) on procedural grounds
column4: This narrow legal sense of annulling a ruling is obscure and more fitting for 'vernietigen', and it confuses learners.
This duplicates the existing 'reading (of a text)' meaning, and the 'reading (act of)' sense is also overlapping.
'Loop' is not a meaning of repetitie, and the real meanings (test, repetition, rehearsal) are already listed.
'Star system' is just another way of saying solar system, which is already listed as a separate meaning.
'Between two' is not a meaning of lesbisch and appears to be a bogus gloss.
Large is not really a meaning of breed and the example just repeats the broad meaning from item 1.
Near-synonym duplicate of the 'captivating' meaning, with no distinct sense.
buss is not a meaningful English gloss and this archaic sense of buis (a type of ship) only confuses learners, while pipe and television are already listed.
Political cartel duplicates the meaning "cartel" of the same word, so it adds nothing.

column3: in a way to cause something to be knocked over
column4: This meaning is essentially the same as the other 'omver' sense (knocked over) and merely duplicates it, with a cumbersome gloss.
It duplicates the 'soft drink' meaning (sweetened drink is the same sense), and the translation uses 'squash' inconsistently.
'To hit with an arrow' is not a meaning of stralen; the sense is invented and confusing.
Stralen does not mean to miscarry; this meaning does not exist.
Stralen does not mean to prick; this is not a real meaning of the word.
Stralen meaning to squirt out is obscure/archaic and confusing for learners.
The gloss 'forum' merely repeats the other meaning 'consultative forum', so this sense is a duplicate.
